behavior: Production Dockerfile multi-stage non-root + image builds with local iris:dev tag + loops REGISTRIES make-var (default 'ghcr.io/mlorentedev/iris docker.io/mlorentedev/iris') creating <registry>:<git-sha-short> + <registry>:0.1.0-dev tags. make docker-push pushes to all registries (ghcr login auto via GITHUB_TOKEN; docker.io login via DOCKER_HUB_USERNAME+DOCKER_HUB_TOKEN secrets, graceful skip if missing).
